'''Surface tintware''' was a type of jewelry that was worn by [[Invertebrate/Legends|invertebrates]]. The [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Kuari Princess]]'' had shops that sold surface tintware.<ref name="Riders of the Maelstorm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Surface tintware was mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement [[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']] written by [[Ray Winninger]] and  published by [[West End Games]] in [[1989]].<ref name="Riders of the Maelstorm" />
